mapper.select: SELECT d.status AS key_value, COUNT(*) AS count_value FROM campaign_delivery d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.send_id = #{sendId} GROUP BY d.status

SELECT d.status AS key_value, COUNT(*) AS count_value FROM campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.campaign_id = #{campaignId} GROUP BY d.status

SELECT d.skip_reason AS key_value, COUNT(*) AS count_value FROM campaign_delivery d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.send_id = #{sendId} AND d.status = 'skipped' AND d.skip_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.skip_reason

SELECT d.skip_reason AS key_value, COUNT(*) AS count_value FROM campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND d.status = 'skipped' AND d.skip_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.skip_reason

SELECT e.event_type AS key_value, COUNT(*) AS count_value FROM campaign_delivery_event e JOIN campaign_delivery d ON d.workspace_id = e.workspace_id AND d.id = e.delivery_id WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.send_id = #{sendId} GROUP BY e.event_type

SELECT e.event_type AS key_value, COUNT(*) AS count_value FROM campaign_delivery_event e JOIN campaign_delivery d ON d.workspace_id = e.workspace_id AND d.id = e.delivery_id JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.campaign_id = #{campaignId} GROUP BY e.event_type

SELECT s.channel AS key_value, COUNT(d.id) AS count_value FROM campaign_send s LEFT JOIN campaign_delivery d ON d.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND d.send_id = s.id WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.campaign_id = #{campaignId} GROUP BY s.channel
